beats.en: The Moon does not make its own light; it shines by reflecting sunlight, and half of it is always lit by the Sun.
beats.speakEn: The Moon does not make its own light; it shines by reflecting sunlight, and half of it is always lit by the Sun.

beats.en: The Moon goes round the Earth once in about 27.3 days, and we see different amounts of its lit half, called phases.
beats.speakEn: The Moon goes round the Earth once in about 27.3 days, and we see different amounts of its lit half, called phases.
